data.title: Rejection of extended curfew exception for Café "Fleetblick"
data.case_title: Rejection of request to extend café closing-time exception (Bezirksamt Beispielbek)
data.summary: Bezirksamt Beispielbek, Fachamt Verbraucherschutz, Gewerbe und Umwelt, rejected Lavinia Beispielfleet's application to extend the curfew exception (Sperrzeit-Ausnahme) for her café "Fleetblick" to allow opening until 2 a.m. on Fridays and Saturdays, citing repeated noise complaints and police interventions. The letter is dated 19 November 2026 and includes legal remedy instructions (Widerspruch).
data.explanation: The district office turned down your request to keep the café open later on Friday and Saturday nights, because of repeated noise complaints and police call-outs. You may file a written objection (Widerspruch) if you disagree with this decision; the app shows the deadline for this based on when the letter is deemed delivered. If you do nothing, the rejection stands and the current, shorter opening hours continue to apply. If you want to contest the factual basis (e.g. the noise complaints), consider getting legal advice, as the letter does not explain further appeal options beyond the Widerspruch.

key_facts.quote: Ein Bescheid, den die Behörde mit einfachem Brief verschickt, gilt am vierten Tag nach der Aufgabe zur Post als bekannt gegeben (§ 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG).
